lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Carmela Shea is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Carmela is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
d40: 🕯️ Carmela Shea is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Carmela kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Carmela's gone." Shannon looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Carmela." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Pearl blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Carmela Shea, 40 days. The mantle passes to Pearl Powell.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Pearl Powell, 18 — a bike messenger. Her hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Bird Whisperer, Trophy Room.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Carmela — and Carmela is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Shannon, Moshe, Samuel and 5 more speak for Pearl — "Carmela trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Pearl before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
